Full Iran coverage

We clear your goods through every Iranian crossing into Iraq

Iranian ports & transit routes to Iraq

  • Shahid Rajaee Port — Bandar AbbasIran's largest container port; containers from China and Asia continue overland in transit to Mehran–Zurbatiyah or Shalamcheh
  • Bandar Imam Khomeini — KhuzestanTransit towards the Shalamcheh and Chazabeh crossings for Basra and Maysan
  • Khorramshahr PortClose to the Shalamcheh crossing and Basra
  • Bushehr PortGeneral cargo and containers heading to the southern crossings
  • Chabahar PortIran's gateway on the Indian Ocean for cargo from Asia
  • Iran's land borders with its neighboursOverland transit through Iran to Iraq from Turkey, Turkmenistan, Azerbaijan, Armenia, Pakistan and Afghanistan

FAQ

Everything you need to know about customs clearance via Iran

Straight answers to the questions importers and exporters ask us most.

Do you clear goods coming from Iran into Iraq?

Yes. Al-Bait Al-Iraqi for Customs Clearance is based at the Zurbatiyah border crossing in Wasit, Iraq, directly opposite Iran's Mehran crossing. We clear goods imported from Iran and transit cargo moving through Iran via every land crossing between Iraq and Iran, and we also handle exports from Iraq to Iran.

Are you a customs broker or a freight company?

We are a customs broker office: we handle the customs formalities for your goods when they enter or leave Iraq — filing the declaration, inspection, paying duties and release — and we follow the transit on the Iranian side up to the crossing. We do not own trucks or ships, but we coordinate with the carrier you work with.

How do I choose a customs broker for imports between Iran and Iraq?

Choose a broker with a real presence at the crossing your goods enter through, who works at every crossing between Iran and Iraq rather than a single one, speaks Arabic and Persian to follow both sides, reviews your documents before shipping, and gives you a written quote and a clear clearance time. Al-Bait Al-Iraqi meets these conditions: an office at the Zurbatiyah crossing since 2015, coverage of all seven crossings, and a team working in Arabic, Persian, English and Chinese.

Which Iraq–Iran border crossings do you work at?

All official land crossings: Zurbatiyah–Mehran, Al-Sheeb–Chazabeh, Shalamcheh, Al-Mundhiriya–Khosravi, Haj Omran–Tamarchin, Bashmakh–Bashmaq and Parwezkhan–Parviz Khan. We also follow shipments arriving from Iranian ports such as Bandar Abbas and Bandar Imam Khomeini.

How long does customs clearance take at Zurbatiyah?

Our average is about 3 working days after the truck arrives and the documents are complete. It varies with the type of goods, inspections and permits. We review your documents before shipping to avoid delays.

What documents do I need to import goods from Iran into Iraq?

Usually: commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, transport document (CMR for road or bill of lading for sea), an Iraqi import licence where required, a certificate of conformity (COC) for regulated goods, and a health or phytosanitary certificate for food. We review the documents before shipping to avoid fines and delays.

Can I ship goods from China to Iraq via Iran?

Yes — it is a common route. Containers are discharged at Shahid Rajaee Port in Bandar Abbas, travel overland through Iran under transit to Mehran–Zurbatiyah, Shalamcheh or another crossing, and we clear them through customs on entry into Iraq.

Do you also clear exports from Iraq to Iran?

Yes. We handle export formalities — export declarations, certificates of origin and coordination with the relevant authorities — for products such as Iraqi dates.

What kinds of goods do you clear?

All commercial goods: foodstuffs, steel and building materials, marble, heavy machinery, and specialised cargo such as medical and chemical materials, including the permits they require.

How do I get a customs clearance quote?

Send your shipment details (goods, weight, border crossing) on WhatsApp to +964 773 756 5367 or through the form on this website, and we will send you a quote within 24 hours.

Where is your office and what are your working hours?

Our office is at the Zurbatiyah border crossing, Badra district, Wasit Governorate, Iraq. We work Sunday to Thursday, 8:00 to 17:00, and you can reach us on WhatsApp or at support@iqbait.com.

Why choose Al-Bait Al-Iraqi?

More than 11 years of experience since 2015, over 3,000 shipments cleared between Iraq and Iran, a permanent presence at the Zurbatiyah crossing, and follow-up at every step from request to release.
